children: Bubblemaps (BMT) spot trading opens on Upbit's KRW market at 12:00 KST on 24 Oct 2026.

Upbit is Korea's largest won-denominated exchange, giving BMT direct access to a major market for Korean won trading. The new spot market adds a route for traders on the platform to buy and sell BMT in won. It also expands the token's visibility among the exchange's users and provides an additional venue for spot liquidity.

title: Bubblemaps: BMT opens spot trading on Upbit's KRW market - 24 Oct 2026
